_about: w22: the rules of a Text widget's text, pinned for BOTH sides. backend/dcdash/core/widgets.py (pytest: tests/test_widget_config.py) and frontend/src/lib/textWidget.ts (vitest: textWidget.test.ts) must give the same answer for every case. Order of the rules: (1) CR LF and lone CR become LF; (2) refuse control characters (every code point U+0000 to U+001F except TAB and LF, U+007F, U+0080 to U+009F) with reason control, and lone surrogates (U+D800 to U+DFFF) with reason invalid; (3) trim both ends with trim_set; (4) count Unicode code points of what is left: heading 1 to 200 and no LF inside, paragraph 1 to 2000, divider exactly 0. A case holds text or repeat [string, times]; ok cases give the stored text (stored, or stored_repeat) and its code point count.
